name: Qdrant MCP server
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C4, C6, C7, C8; partly meets C1, C2, C3, C5, C10; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The PyPI record for mcp-server-qdrant 0.8.1 lists no project or repository URL; the repository's `pyproject.toml` declares the package name `mcp-server-qdrant`. PyPI holds no provenance attestation for the release (the integrity record returned HTTP 404).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected"; the same page offers private vulnerability reporting ("Report a vulnerability").

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived. The latest release is 339 days old (more than 180); repository activity falls within the last 180 days. Latest release 0.8.1 is dated 2025-12-10; the newest commit on `master` is dated 2026-11-10; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-10.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The store tool is available unless read-only mode is set. Quoted: “`QDRANT_READ_ONLY` | Enable read-only mode (disables `qdrant-store` tool) | `false` |”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The API key is supplied through an environment variable. Quoted: “`QDRANT_API_KEY` | API key for the Qdrant server”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`uv.lock`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: fastmcp==2.7.0. Lower-bound version 2.7.0 of fastmcp (PyPI) was published on 2025-06-05, between 12 and 24 months before 2026-11-14.
